description: T-061 shared policy. Three managers: root pnpm (package.json + pnpm-lock.yaml), desktop/web pnpm, and cargo (src-tauri). rangeStrategy is 'auto' (not 'pin') because these repos commit lockfiles while manifests keep version ranges: Renovate updates the range in the manifest and the resolved version in the lockfile together.

packageRules.description: All minor+patch updates grouped into a single PR per ecosystem.

Security updates need no extra rule: with vulnerabilityAlerts enabled, Renovate natively raises dedicated immediate PRs for vulnerable dependencies, bypassing the weekend schedule and the minor+patch group, labelled security.
Tauri major updates are NOT disabled — they are grouped: the JS side (@tauri-apps/*) and the Rust side (src-tauri/Cargo.toml) must land together in one coordinated PR.
Rust half of the Tauri major-update group: tauri and tauri-build/plugins in src-tauri/Cargo.toml share the same groupName as the @tauri-apps/* JS packages so Renovate combines them into a single PR.
